name: Saotome Takuya
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend, he has been reunited with the latter due to him enrolling in Baramon High School after a 7 year leave.
Unskilled in both sport and study fields, Takuya is cheerful and takes care of others nonetheless. 
His family runs an Okonomiyaki shop.

"That part of you hasn't changed at all, huh..."
